evidence.detail: Exact v308 iterates rs/d/k item definitions, compares current and baseline/template entries, and records changed name/note/template/actions/groundActions, stack data, model/zoom/rotations/offsets, recolors/retextures, resize, worn/chat models, ambient and contrast fields.
Bootstrap/string evidence includes 'Found differences in item ...', '..Dump completed!', 'Running test..', '..Test completed!', and generated i.yaml / i.bin output names under the client data path.
The embedded regression/test path explicitly references item data such as 'Dwarf remains', Drop, broken/template/clone handling, confirming item-definition rather than generic object serialization.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 iterates NPC definitions, compares rs/d/d current entries against their baseline/template entries, and records changed name, combatLevel, actions, models, recolors/retextures, animations, scale, minimap, headIcon, pet/clickable and related fields.
Bootstrap/string evidence includes 'Found differences in NPC ...', '..Dump completed!', and generated e.yaml / e.bin output names rooted under the client data path.
The dump entry point is gated by the client configuration/development mode value before walking up to 25,000 NPC definition slots.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 creates ./debug when absent and opens ./debug/textures.txt through FileReader/BufferedReader.

The loader clears six integer lists, ignores # comment lines, switches parse mode on [textur], [random], and [recolor] section markers, and parses comma-separated integer entries into the corresponding lists.
The class is a static debug-file loader with no gameplay construction state; its only bytecode referrer is its nested section-mode helper.
